_about: Scripted iMessages from Nora, sent from this Mac's Messages app to NORA_IMESSAGE_TO. {first}, {count}, {total}, {order}, {driver} and {eta} are filled in when the texts are sent.
start: Hi {first}, it's Nora from The Club. You stepped away with {count} in your cart, {total} with free delivery tonight.
Reply YES and I'll send it, or tell me what you'd like to change.
confirmed: {driver} is on his way and should be with you around {eta}. He'll check your ID at the door.
other: No problem. Reply YES whenever you're ready, or open the shop and I'll help you change it.
after: Your order's on its way. Reply here anytime if you need anything.
